response.overview: According to folklore, the ointment is the essential element for practicing witchcraft—a magical concoction of herbs and other mysterious ingredients that the *Janare* jealously guard in small vials. *L'Unguento* is the story of a woman alone with her grief and her nocturnal spiritual journeys. It is the tale of a mother who falls victim to prejudice and fear. It is a narrative about how a community, seeking to shake up its monotonous daily routine, feels the need to create threatening figures to fight—thereby becoming the very source of Evil itself.
response.title: The Ointment
